chunks: I asked him about enjoying sexual relations with a virgin if she is between her parents without the permission of her parents. He said, 'There is no harm, as long as he does not take from there [the dowry/wealth] so that she may be chaste/modest by that.'

key_terms.لِتَعِفَّ: So that she may be chaste/modest

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to have sexual relations with a virgin wife without her parents' permission according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that a virgin's marriage is valid and sexual relations permissible without her parents' explicit consent, provided the husband pays the dowry (*mahr*) from his own wealth. This ruling emphasizes that the financial provision secures her modesty (*ta'iff*) and rights, distinguishing the validity of the contract from the necessity of parental approval in Shia jurisprudence.
